highlights.description: Read a Google Doc's suggested edits and any file's comments
Opt-in upload and update tools, off by default, confined to an upload root, and audit-logged
Deny-by-default tool authorization with `drive:read` and `drive:write` scopes

added.description: `get_document_suggestions`: a Google Doc's text split into original, inserted, and deleted segments by suggested edits, with each block's original and accepted text
Drive skill with `get_file_comments`: comments on any file with quoted text, resolved state, and replies
`upload_file` and `update_file`: upload or replace a Drive file, optionally converting it to a Doc, Sheet, or Slides file, registered only with `--enable-write`
`--enable-write` / `MCP_GOOGLE_ENABLE_WRITE` and `--upload-root` / `MCP_GOOGLE_UPLOAD_ROOT`; write mode also requests the `drive.file` Google scope
Write tools confine local paths to the upload root (including symbolic links) with oscompat, refuse files over 50 MB, return `{code,message}` errors, and audit-log every call
`drive:read` and `drive:write` policy scopes
CLI commands `get-document-suggestions`, `get-file-comments`, `upload-file`, and `update-file`
Authorization through an explicit tool-to-scope table; a tool with no entry is denied when a token carries a scope claim

changed.description: Docs, Sheets, and Slides skills call gogoogle instead of building Google API clients; a test fails on any direct client use
Upgrade `github.com/grokify/gogoogle` from v0.11.1 to v0.13.0 and add `github.com/grokify/oscompat` v0.10.0

tests.description: Guard that fails if a skill imports API client options, builds an API service, or finishes a request itself, and fake-API tests for every skill
Every registered tool has exactly one scope mapping, including the write tools
Write mode: confinement, error codes, audit records, scopes, and an MCP round trip

documentation.description: Add the tools reference for Drive and suggestions, write-mode configuration and scope documentation, and v0.5.0 release notes
Describe the per-tool scope map and deny-unmapped behavior

highlights.description: Streamable-HTTP transport secured by ID-JAG (Enterprise-Managed Authorization) resource-server verification

added.description: `serve --http` / `MCP_GOOGLE_HTTP_ADDR`: opt-in streamable-HTTP transport (stdio remains the default)
`--idjag-issuer`, `--idjag-audience`, `--idjag-jwks-url` flags: verify bearer JWTs as a pure OAuth resource server via the agent-protocols ID-JAG adapter
`internal/emauth` middleware: audit-logs the verified identity (sub, act chain, scope) on every tool call and gates tools by scope (`docs:read`, `sheets:read`, `slides:read`)
Skills now report a `Version()` (docs, sheets, slides all at v0.5.0)

fixed.description: Auth: avoid a panic from `omnitoken.NewFromCredentials(name, nil)` when initializing the service-account token manager

changed.description: Upgrade `omniskill` from v0.10.0 to v0.12.0, adding the external resource-server auth support the HTTP transport depends on

documentation.description: Add v0.4.0 release notes and HTTP transport / ID-JAG configuration guide

highlights.description: Google Sheets support with 5 new tools for reading spreadsheets

added.description: `skills/sheets`: New Google Sheets skill with 5 tools
`get_spreadsheet_metadata` tool: Get spreadsheet metadata (title, sheet count, locale, time zone)
`list_sheets` tool: List all sheets with properties (rows, columns, frozen)
`get_sheet_values` tool: Get cell values from a specific range with typed output
`get_sheet_data` tool: Get all data from a specific sheet
`get_multiple_ranges` tool: Batch get values from multiple ranges
CLI: `get-spreadsheet-metadata`, `list-sheets`, `get-sheet-values`, `get-sheet-data` commands
Auth: Add `spreadsheets.readonly` OAuth scope

changed.description: Upgrade `gogoogle` from v0.10.0 to v0.11.0 for sheetsutil/v4 support

documentation.description: Update README, CLI reference, and tools overview for Sheets

`get_document_content` tool: Get structured content with images and tables
